Interface IHasPopover

Namespace: osu.Framework.Graphics.Cursor

GetPopover()

Creates the osu.Framework.Graphics.UserInterface.Popover to display for this control. Supports returning null if the popover should only display in some cases (e.g. if the control is not disabled).
